howto.name: Upload a WebP image
howto.text: Drop a .webp file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools converts via Pillow
howto.text: Uncompressed output; the alpha channel is dropped, so transparent areas usually come out black.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Run the conversion. BMP is uncompressed and drops transparency, which usually leaves those areas black; it is worth using only when some older tool insists on it.

faq.a: To use a modern WebP image in older software or hardware that only reads uncompressed bitmaps. The BMP is a raw, maximally-compatible copy.
The BMP is a lossless copy of the decoded WebP pixels; if the source WebP was lossy, those pixels are already final and can't be improved.
No. Files are temporary and are removed by response cleanup after the download is sent; a background sweep clears anything an interrupted request leaves behind.
